# Delteris / Elenchon

> Engineering the technology for Europe's future.

Elenchon is on-premise welding traceability software for fabrication shops and heavy industry. It runs the full WPS/WPQR/WPQ qualification workflow, turns floor capture into audit-ready ISO and ASME IX evidence, captures shop-floor data in seconds, and keeps every weld record on the client's own hardware via Phrakton — Delteris's zero-trust network overlay built on OpenZiti and secured with post-quantum cryptography.

## Core Pillars
- Zero-Friction Work Capture (10-second navigation, universal work templates)
- One Project, Two Live Views (Tree & Flowchart, one-paste BOM import from Tekla or most CAD packages, joint types & joining sequence, repeatable-batch bulk instantiation)
- Management & Access Control (global custom roles, one-click document generation, role-filtered notifications and setup/WPS health advisories, joint repair cycles & dispositions)
- Qualifications & Procedures (WPS/WPQR/WPQ workflow, 6-month continuity tracking, heat propagation)
- Floor Asset & Consumable Control (maintenance hub, machine certification tracking, batch inventory) - Standard only; Lite excludes these
- Bulletproof Data Sovereignty (on-premise appliance, automated local backups, tamper-evident hash-chained log of weighty management-console actions, post-quantum-safe encryption)

A full plan-by-plan feature comparison (every capability by Lite/Standard/Premium) is on the pricing page: https://delteris.com/pricing.html#compare

## Pricing (EUR, per appliance, per month, excl. VAT)
- Lite: €390/month, 20 workers included. The full traceability core — work capture, project tree and flowchart, BOM import, WPS/WPQR/WPQ workflow, ISO & ASME IX records, global custom roles and granular permissions, elastic templates, Phrakton networking, local backups, founder support by email. Expandable by up to two 10-worker blocks, to a 40-worker ceiling. Lite excludes the maintenance hub, machine certification tracking, consumable traceability, and offline work capture.
- Standard: €790/month, 50 workers included (under €1,000/month including Portuguese VAT). Everything in Lite plus the in-app maintenance hub, machine certification and calibration tracking, consumable traceability (batch/heat/expiry, traced into welds), offline work capture, a pre-deployment on-site scoping session, on-site training run as two 3-hour blocks, unlimited worker expansion blocks, and direct founder support.
- Premium: coming soon.
- Add-ons: Remote Access Module €200/month (incl. 100 GB); Additional Workers €9/month per seat, sold in blocks of 10 (€90/month per block), each block including 20 GB of recurring remote bandwidth free; Remote Bandwidth €25 per 100 GB. Included blocks (20 on Lite, 50 on Standard) are covered by the base rate; per-seat pricing applies only beyond the included count.
- Plan changes: upgrades, downgrades and add-ons are applied remotely over the Phrakton fabric at no charge. Give at least 15 days' notice. Upgrades apply immediately; downgrades at the next billing cycle.
- One-time: Lite Deployment & Training package €950 (installation plus one training session of two 2-hour blocks; no separate pre-deployment scoping visit, so it's one on-site trip instead of two — that is why it costs less than Standard); Standard Deployment & Training €1,700 all in (€850 deployment + €850 floor training, including a separate on-site scoping visit that typically runs about half a day, training run as two 3-hour blocks); Server Appliance ~€300–400 at cost (or your own hardware choice, sourced to spec at cost); Data Migration — bespoke, by selective request, POA/custom-quoted. Not part of a standard deployment; the recommended path is that clients enter their own projects and WPS/WPQR library (the app is built for that). For clients who prefer to arrive fully loaded, Delteris will key in their structure and procedure library before go-live for a custom fee quoted to the volume, accepted at its discretion — a considered extra for those who need it; On-Site Commute Fee €150/visit for standalone visits (extra training or support) within national range — national deployment transport is free and never carries this fee. Delteris is based in Portugal and deploys across the EU and beyond; international and out-of-range sites do NOT get free deployment transport — they carry a single custom travel fee (quoted up front) in place of both the free national deployment transport and the €150 standalone fee.
- Professional services: Extra Training Session €500 half day (a single 3-hour session) / €850 full day (two 3-hour blocks — the full day is the lower hourly rate); Network Consulting €500 half day / €850 full day; PQS (post-quantum security) Consulting €500 half day / €850 full day. Network and post-quantum security consulting do not require running Elenchon — they are available to any organisation as standalone engagements.
- Uptime: 99.9% monthly commitment on the Phrakton fabric, with automatic invoice credits when missed — 10% for 99.0–99.8%, 25% for 97.0–99.0%, 50% for 90.0–97.0%, and 100% (the month is free) below 89.9%.
- Billing: nothing is charged at deployment except installation and training. The monthly subscription begins after go-live; the first monthly invoice falls on the 1st or the 15th, whichever is furthest from the go-live date. Twelve invoices per year, one per calendar month — no 28-day cycles and no thirteenth invoice.
- No per-audit fees, no lock-in — customers who cancel keep view-only access to historical data for audits.

## Deployment
Three steps: scoping session with the founders, on-site installation of the hardware appliance, then onboarding and go-live. Deployment slots per quarter are limited because every appliance is installed on-site by Delteris engineers. Lite deployments skip the separate scoping visit — one on-site trip instead of two — and include a single training session of two 2-hour blocks; Standard includes the scoping visit (typically about half a day on-site) and training run as two 3-hour blocks.
